title: Public talks & engagement
text:
I am passionate about sharing my knowledge of the Thames Estuary with wider audiences.
I offer accessible and engaging public talks exploring the ecology, biodiversity, environmental history and conservation of the Thames Estuary.

Talk topics

Fishes and habitats of the Thames Estuary
From pollution to recovery
Restoring the Thames

I welcome invitations from local societies, community groups, museums, educational institutions, environmental organisations and public event organisers.
Talks can be tailored to different audiences and delivered in person or online.

title: Wanda Bodnar
text:
I am a Chartered Marine Scientist with diverse experience across academia, industry (offshore), and the charity sector. Since 2016, I have worked on aquatic habitat conservation, restoration, and climate resilience projects in the Thames Estuary.
I also lead ecology-focused stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) sessions, blending natural history education with outdoor activities.
Currently, I am a research student at the London NERC Doctoral Training Partnership programme.

title: Research
text:
My PhD focuses on fish community responses to intertidal habitat condition and restoration across the Thames Estuary.
Further information about my PhD project, research objectives, methodology and progress is available on my dedicated research website.
